Definition: contracted from Latin Lucanus; Lucas, a Christian:--Lucas, Luke.
BiblicalUsage: Loukâs is the name of Luke, the beloved physician. In Colossians 4:14, "the beloved physician"; and in 2 Timothy 4:11, "Only Luke is with me.". In Philemon 1:24, "Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Luke is the beloved physician who stayed — when everyone else left, only Luke was with Paul. I hold that the man who wrote two books of the Bible did it as a fellow labourer, not a bystander.
